label: Arkansas flag layout context
adaptation_note: Separate band layout, source-centre position overview, nine grouped border-star details and four-star interior. All 29 stars accounted for; grouped count panels do not assert original distances.
acceptance_requirement: Account for all 25 border and four interior stars. Preserve segment continuation and do not use a plain band as a substitute.

frames.title: Diamond-band field layout
frames.teaching_key: Arkansas teaching layout: red field, blue diamond band, white interior. This frame shows band position only. Twenty-five white border stars and four blue interior stars are supplied in the following position/count/detail panels. No visible lettering is represented by this collection.

frames.title: Twenty-five border-star positions
frames.teaching_key: Single pins show the twenty-five source star centres around the diamond in conventional horizontal orientation. They are position cues, not complete star outlines. The following grouped outlines account for the same 25 stars in source clockwise order from the top.

checks.position_encoding: one pin per centre; glyph form supplied separately

frames.teaching_key: Border stars 1 to 3 of 25 in the source clockwise ordering from the top. These are enlarged glyph/count details; horizontal spacing here is not their flag position. Use the position overview to locate them. White stars in the blue border.
